{
  "clearExpectedBehavior": true,
  "rationale": "The report explicitly requires one hit per enemy on each leg, independent of timestep. Original source sets orb damage to 100 + 0.5*AP: with AP 0 and MR 40, one outward hit deals 100*100/140 = 71.42857 health; one return hit directly removes 100 health. These preserve existing per-hit balance. Speed 11 and outward range 8 support the selected outward and return checkpoints at both timesteps. No post-cast state is manufactured. The trace reproduces excess damage, including timestep-dependent outward damage. Retained cumulative checks prevent a passing return delta or death from concealing earlier excess damage. Off-path checks provide controls. This witness covers the supplied stationary-target cases, not all enemies or all timesteps.",
  "checks": [

      "label": "Fine outward hits once",
      "at": "fine_outward",
      "unit": "enemy",
      "field": "hp",
      "relation": "eq",

      "compareUnit": "enemy",
      "compareField": "hp",

      "tolerance": 0.01
    },
